cases.title: Independent business profiles on the same engine
steps: Identify one immutable candidate revision and configure the fixture profiles for shops, co-ownerships and digital projects using public configuration operations.
Validate and publish the synthetic configurations with their declared test dependencies; enter, discover, qualify and follow a target under each profile.
For the digital project, omit company, address, city, email and sector-specific identifiers; inspect engine revision and saved profile definitions.
assertions: All three journeys use the same engine revision and configurable target types, labels, attributes and criteria; no sector-specific source or technology is required by the suite.
The project without geographic or email fields remains searchable, assessable and followable, with contact unavailability explicit.

Each profile declares identity/publication, target and related types, identity rules, acquisition, evidence/freshness/unknown handling, qualification, priority, follow-up, contact content, evaluation and dependencies as described by the locked targeting-profile.md.

cases.title: Reject invalid profiles and attempts to grant authority
steps: Attempt publication separately with an unknown rule, missing reference, incompatible attribute type, invalid identity rule and absent evidence/freshness/outcome definitions.
Attempt activation with a missing source dependency and with profile content asking to remove restriction-a or grant extra access.
Inspect localized validation errors, permissions, restrictions and independent source/channel activation records before and after each attempt.
assertions: Invalid references, rules, types and required profile definitions are localized and block dependent publication or activation.
A content profile cannot change authorization or compliance rules or erase an opposition; source and channel activation are separate decisions.
Missing dependencies remain visible and do not fabricate an enabled connector.

cases.title: Immutable profile publication and explicit reevaluation
steps: Publish profile v1 and accept a fixture evaluation with attributable evidence; start a discovery execution under v1.
Attempt to edit the published version, then publish v2 with a changed mandatory criterion and inspect the impact preview.
Inspect existing evaluations before explicit migration, then request an authorized reevaluation and compare attributed histories.
assertions: The published definition stays immutable and executions/evaluations identify the exact profile version.
Existing accepted evaluations retain v1, evidence and author until an explicit reevaluation or migration decision.
The impact preview identifies affected records; reevaluation creates an attributed v2 evaluation without rewriting the earlier decision.

cases.title: Shared contacts, campaign independence and temporal roles
steps: Create target-a and target-b with a shared contact and two independent campaign dossiers for target-a.
Advance only dossier-a, expire one contact relationship and retain another relationship with explicitly unknown dates.
Repeat the relationship journey with digital projects, and assess target-without-contact.
assertions: Shared contacts do not merge target identities and advancing dossier-a leaves the other campaign stage unchanged.
Multiple dated or explicitly unknown roles are retained; actions depending on an expired relationship require review before use.
A target without a contact remains discoverable and assessable; contact inability is explicit and no address or mandate is invented.

cases.title: Partial discovery, cancellation and bounded resume
steps: Inspect source declarations and exercise manual entry, import and the configurable external test-source boundary.
Inject source-unavailable and unsupported-filter separately; run discovery with declared time, volume, cost and frequency limits.
Cancel after a confirmed result, then resume the same execution and inspect results, budget and stop reasons.
assertions: Actual access, license/reuse conditions, available attributes, collection time and source limits are declared; absent access is explicit.
Applied and unsupported filters, partial coverage, errors, progress and stop reasons are observable; failure never becomes an exhaustive empty market.
Resume preserves confirmed items without duplicates and total time, volume, cost and request frequency remain within the approved execution budget.

cases.title: Promotion does not grant qualification or contact permission
steps: Preview candidates and their source evidence; promote one through an attributed selection and another through a previously approved promotion rule.
Omit evidence of need and permission to contact; inspect dossier state, dimension results and the test transport ledger.
assertions: Candidates and provenance are visible before promotion and the selection or approved rule is recorded.
Promoted dossiers remain for examination; public indicators never prove need, budget, decision power or purchase intent.
Promotion creates no transmission, commercial qualification or sequence enrollment; missing evidence and contact permission remain visible.

cases.title: Inbound durability, idempotency and distinct consent
steps: Open the public fixture form with required information visible and optional future-marketing consent unchecked; disable advertising tracking.
Submit submission-a, repeat its identity and content, then submit a distinct legitimate request from the same contact.
Inject failure before durable receipt on a separate attempt, retry with the same submission identity and inspect requests and acknowledgements.
assertions: The accessible form uses profile-minimal fields and separates service purpose, data information and optional marketing.
The identical submission produces one request; the new legitimate request remains separate and both reference the reconciled contact.
Every request has a user or identified responsible queue with a deadline; source, form version, date and actual information/consent evidence are retained.
No marketing consent or qualified status is inferred, advertising tracking is unnecessary, and receipt is acknowledged only after durable recording.

cases.title: Public form abuse and untrusted instructions
steps: Submit invalid fields, the fixture injection text and a burst exceeding the declared test abuse limit.
Inspect public errors, review isolation, internal access attempts and the destination monitor; include model processing only when AI is enabled.
assertions: Validation and abuse limits reject, bound or isolate suspicious submissions for review with accessible error feedback.
Public submissions expose no internal portfolio and cannot grant rights or change recipients, policy or actions.
No unauthorized external effect or canary transfer occurs; untrusted-content action checks apply even without a model.

cases.title: Ambiguous identity, attributed merge and safe split
steps: Import same-name and shared-email candidates with different reliable identifiers and issuer namespaces, including the same value in another workspace.
Inspect possible matches; reject an unapproved ambiguous merge, then explicitly approve a fixture merge with conflicting evidence and restrictions.
Erase the fixture removable datum, split the mistaken merge through public operations and compare identity, dossiers, activities and restrictions.
assertions: Keys are scoped by type, issuer and workspace; shared name, address or email alone never establishes universal identity.
Ambiguous matches require review; authorized merge preserves prior identifiers, evidence, dossiers, activities, restrictions and the attributed decision.
Split repairs the mistaken merge without restoring erased personal data or removing a corresponding restriction.

cases.title: Contradictions, human corrections and expired evidence
steps: Record an attributed human correction and accepted evaluation with valid evidence.
Enrich from a contradictory source, advance the controlled clock beyond evidence validity, then reevaluate.
Inspect value provenance, observation/declaration/inference labels, current validity and the retained decision history.
assertions: Determinant values retain source, locator and date; contradictions, missing data and expiry remain explicit.
Enrichment does not silently overwrite the correction and attributed history remains available within declared retention.
An expired evaluation loses current-use validity and requires review; unknown, stale or estimated values do not silently become verified facts.

cases.title: Mandatory evidence gates qualification despite a high score
steps: Assess a high-priority target with coordinates but missing mandatory need evidence; repeat with stale evidence and an unavailable source.
Attempt commercial acceptance, record a separately labelled human exception, then supply valid evidence and perform authorized acceptance.
Inspect per-criterion decisions, four independent dimensions, method version, correction reasons and acceptance attribution.
assertions: Every criterion reports satisfied, not satisfied or unknown with evidence, validity and reason; missing data or failed collection is unknown, never negative evidence.
A missing mandatory criterion blocks ordinary acceptance regardless of total score; a human exception neither verifies unknown facts nor receives the ordinary qualified label.
Fit, demonstrated need, data quality and contactability stay distinct; relevant target and commercial qualification have distinct names.
Method, criteria, evidence and score limitations are versioned and visible; heuristics are not conversion probabilities.
The positive acceptance control has valid mandatory evidence and an authorized attributed decision; rejection and corrections retain author and reason.

cases.title: Transfer and concurrent edits preserve responsibility
steps: Prepare an active dossier with a responsible user and dated task, plus a second dossier with a reasoned dated wait.
Transfer responsibility while two authorized clients edit the next action from the same revision.
Apply a previewed batch from a saved segment containing a concurrently changed row; compare list and progression views with identical filters.
assertions: Transfer confirms the new responsible user or queue and preserves activities, deadlines and restrictions.
Every active dossier retains a dated next action or reasoned wait with review date; conflicting edits are explicit with zero silent loss.
List and progression views agree on filters, rights and state; saved segments add no rights.
Batch preview shows impacts and the result classifies each row, including concurrency conflicts, without silently replacing newer data.

cases.title: Pipeline gates, closure and reasoned reopening
steps: Publish stages, permitted transitions, evidence gates and terminal outcomes; attempt a transition without its required evidence.
Close a dossier with a result, then reopen with a reason and new dated action; inspect qualification, restrictions and stage history.
assertions: The unsupported or ungated transition is refused with its reason.
Closure and reopening require a result or reason and preserve the previous outcome and attributed history.
Pipeline movement never erases qualification or restrictions; the reopened active dossier has a responsible owner and a next action or dated wait.

cases.title: DST-aware reminders and attributed activity correction
steps: Create a task across the fixture daylight-saving boundary; plan, postpone, complete and cancel tasks through separate public attempts.
Exercise reminder preferences, pauses, revoked access and overdue status; inspect due instants with their time zones.
Correct a past interaction and compare it with a suggestion, planned task and transport event.
assertions: Task deadline and time zone stay interpretable across the clock change; reminders are not duplicated and respect preferences, rights and pauses.
Overdue tasks are visible; completion or cancellation has an attributed result.
Observed interactions, planned tasks, suggestions and transport events stay distinct with actor, occurrence/receipt times and recipients.
The correction is attributed and preserves history within retention without inventing an additional completed interaction.

cases.title: Human approval binds every final message field
steps: Approve a fixture final message as an authorized human, retaining sender, recipient, channel and purpose.
In separate attempts change content, sender, recipient, channel or purpose and request transmission.
Inspect approval records, drafts, activity metrics and the isolated transport ledger; include an unchanged approved positive control.
assertions: Approval is attributed to a human and bound to the exact final message and every delivery field.
Each changed element invalidates approval and prevents provider handoff until renewed review.
A draft or denied attempt is not an activity counted as sent; only the authorized unchanged control is handed off.
Batch approval, when offered, exposes every recipient and final content and authorizes no future generated unreviewed message.

cases.title: Restriction and revocation race at the handoff boundary
steps: Queue an approved message and hold execution before provider handoff using a declared test barrier.
Confirm opposition or revoke actor rights before releasing the barrier; separately invalidate policy, contact permission, relationship, approval and quota.
Repeat a competing handoff/opposition ordering and compare independently observed transport events with control timestamps.
assertions: Immediately before handoff the actor, current policy, permission, opposition, relationship, final approval and caps are all checked.
A missing or failed check blocks with a reason and no subsequent prohibited provider handoff.
Opposition is applied across its real workspace/purpose/channel scope and the chronology distinguishes confirmation from provider handoff.
A message already handed off is reported truthfully and never claimed to be remotely recalled.

cases.title: Unknown remote outcome and disordered confirmations
steps: Use the controlled test transport to accept one approved operation, then drop its network acknowledgement or fail the local result recording.
Attempt recovery; deliver authenticated duplicate and reordered provider events, plus an unauthenticated event.
Repeat with a test provider that cannot deduplicate or reconcile the original handoff; inspect operation identity and the independent send ledger.
assertions: The uncertain attempt retains one stable operation identity and is not treated as absent merely because local confirmation failed.
Reconciliation prevents a second blind send; authenticated events reconcile by event and operation identity with no duplicate logical effect or confirmed-state regression.
Provider acceptance is distinct from confirmed delivery, failure and unknown outcome; delivery is never invented.
Unauthenticated events are refused; conflicts and exhausted retries are explicit.
Without provider reconciliation/deduplication, retry stays suspended pending documented resolution.

cases.title: Email sender checks, opt-out and transport suppression
steps: When email is enabled, declare the sender/destination authentication requirements, quotas and stop thresholds applicable to the configured test channel.
Attempt sending with invalid sender identity or authentication; exercise account-free opposition.
Deliver permanent-bounce and complaint test events, then request another affected send.
assertions: Invalid sender or required authentication blocks handoff; no promise of inbox placement is made.
A recipient can register opposition simply without signing in.
Permanent bounces and complaints block subsequent affected attempts and declared quotas/stop thresholds are observable.
cases.applicability: Run when the email channel is enabled or advertised; otherwise record not_run and state the disabled channel.

cases.title: Bounded sequences pause and coordinate across campaigns
steps: Configure sequence steps, maximum attempts, windows/time zone, pauses, stop conditions and two campaigns for the same recipient/channel/purpose.
Approve each final message explicitly, then advance the controlled clock and check global cadence before enrollment and every handoff.
In separate attempts receive a human reply, meeting, refusal, opposition, complaint, permanent bounce, rights loss and an ambiguous/automatic response.
Disable response observability in the test transport; exercise campaign and connector emergency stops.
assertions: No unreviewed future generation is approved by enrollment; every final recipient/content remains explicitly human-approved.
Global workspace cadence applies across campaigns, including enrollment and every step, within declared windows and attempt limits.
Human replies, appointments and applicable restrictions pause affected steps before the next handoff; ambiguous/automatic replies require review before automatic follow-up resumes.
Loss of response observability suspends affected sequences; immediate campaign/connector stop prevents subsequent handoff.
Activity and next actions reflect reply/refusal/meeting outcomes faithfully.

cases.title: Authorization across direct and indirect surfaces
steps: Run the fixture role/scope/operation matrix in two isolated workspaces, including a hidden-record canary and a saved search segment.
Revoke a user and delegated background-task access while dossiers remain active; attempt public reads/writes, search, matching, aggregates, exports, reminders and connectors.
Include AI context when enabled; inspect reassignment, sensitive-change history and documented/verified transit and storage protection.
assertions: Default denial enforces workspace, role, scope and operation rights on every exposed surface, including automation and any AI context.
No out-of-scope result, action or indirect hidden-identity hint is exposed.
Revoked/departed actors cannot use deferred delegation or saved searches as extra authority; active dossiers are reassigned with attributed changes.
Transit and storage protection are supported by reviewable verification artifacts; absence of these artifacts blocks that QA claim.

cases.title: Missing policy blocks only dependent processing
steps: Inspect declared compliance policy scope, sources, effective/review dates and responsible authority independently from the business profile.
In separate attempts omit the relevant population, purpose, jurisdiction, channel, information or contact basis before personal collection or handoff.
When AI is enabled, omit actual-data-category transfer permission and monitor the AI test destination; exercise the independent authorized manual path.
assertions: Collection basis, information, permission to solicit and permission for AI processing remain independent and current.
Unknown or missing required conditions block dependent collection, contact or model calls before transfer.
Public availability, an organization target type or a content profile supplies no missing authorization; no universal B2B basis or retention duration is inferred.
Policy evidence is deployment-specific and externally reviewable; fixture policy proves test decisions only, never legal validity of a real deployment.

cases.title: Scoped suppression survives new data and campaigns
steps: Confirm restriction-a with its actual recipient, purpose and channel scope, then attempt contact through each affected campaign/channel.
Reimport the identity, merge it, change the business profile, reevaluate it and create a new campaign; repeat affected preparation/handoff attempts.
Inspect minimal suppression evidence, permitted purposes and an unrelated-scope control.
assertions: The opposition is effective across all affected dossiers and channels before a new provider handoff.
Import, merge, profile/campaign changes and reevaluation cannot lift the restriction.
Minimal suppression evidence is separated from active targeting use and is retained only for its declared purpose; scope is not silently broadened or narrowed.

cases.title: Retention clocks resist artificial refresh
steps: Declare per-purpose/category retention, its demonstrable starting event and a limited justified exception before running the case.
Advance the controlled clock across outbound follow-up, automatic opening, enrichment and reimport; compare the deadline after every event.
Advance beyond the original deadline and inspect purge, active views and exception usage.
assertions: Each retention deadline derives from the policy and an admissible demonstrated start event.
Outbound contact, automatic reading, reimport and enrichment alone never postpone the deadline.
Expired personal data leaves active use according to policy; exceptions have reason, limits and separate non-commercial usage.
The suite uses synthetic configurable durations and imposes no universal number of retention years.

cases.title: Rights propagation, erasure and safe restoration
steps: Inventory actual destinations, processors, processing locations, reuse permissions, data categories and retention; issue proportionately verified access, correction, opposition and erasure requests.
Inject derived-store or processor unavailability while propagating the requests through indexes, caches and applicable derivatives.
Restore an older backup in isolation and inspect public service before releasing it, including audit/log artifacts and the hidden/erased canaries.
assertions: Requests record verification, applicable deadline, actions, result and outstanding propagation failures; unfinished required work is not labelled complete.
Erasure and restrictions are reapplied before restored data is served or contacts resume; erased content never returns to active use.
Audit history stays attributable during retention but contains no parallel personal-data reconstruction path after lawful erasure.
Actual transfers, processors, locations and reuse conditions are documented; logs minimize personal content and protect secrets.
A pseudonym or simple hash is not represented as irreversible anonymization.

cases.title: AI proposals, grounding and indirect injection
steps: Process the fixture malicious page, message, public form, imported profile and model-output variants under permitted test-data transfer categories.
Ask for analysis and a draft containing an unsupported figure, contact detail and mandate; attempt injected recipient/policy changes and canary exfiltration.
Inspect attributed proposal labels, authorized sources, method/model/configuration versions, budget and actual action/egress ledgers.
assertions: Proposals remain labelled with authorized sources and method/model/configuration versions; unsupported facts stay unknown and estimates never satisfy mandatory evidence.
Content grants no rights, recipients or action authority; independent action checks prevent unauthorized effects and canary exfiltration.
Allowed data categories, authorization, cost, time and volume are checked before model transfer; refusal/correction remain possible.
Internal model reasoning is not retained as business evidence, and human supervision is not claimed as global AI Act compliance.

cases.title: Manual journey under AI outage or refusal
steps: Always perform rule-based qualification, manual draft editing and dated follow-up with the core public controls.
When AI is enabled or advertised, repeat while separately injecting AI unavailability, permission refusal and exhausted processing budget.
Inspect limits and transfer counters, evidence decisions and final-message approval requirements.
assertions: Core qualification, manual editing and follow-up remain usable without AI; absent optional AI is declared explicitly.
For applicable AI fault attempts, limitation/refusal is visible with no over-budget or unauthorized call.
No evidence or final-approval gate is bypassed during degraded operation; disabled optional fault attempts are recorded as not_run, not passing tests.
cases.applicability: The manual core journey always runs. AI fault phases apply only when CAP-PR-013 is enabled or advertised; record absent phases explicitly.

cases.title: Auditable cohorts, distinct counts and scoped reporting
steps: Create two requests for the same target, replay one event and reopen a closed dossier; include a merge, an overdue task and a stalled dossier.
Calculate a declared cohort, period, time zone and attribution from source records, including a zero-denominator cohort.
View authorized dashboards and request an automatic report for a manager with a restricted scope.
assertions: Candidates, unique identities, dossiers, inbound requests, accepted qualifications, transmitted messages, relevant human replies and terminal outcomes have distinct counts.
Each metric declares denominator, cohort, period, time zone, attribution and freshness; zero denominator is non-computable.
Merge, duplicate event and reopening create no new conversion; overdue/stagnant dossiers, stage time and rejection reasons are visible using declared thresholds.
The report cites aggregates and calculation time, discloses missing data and exposes only its recipient-authorized scope.

cases.title: Import conflict and semantic export round trip
steps: Preview the fixture batch, map fields and validate each row; import duplicate, invalid, restricted and unchanged rows using one operation key.
Replay the same key and payload, then reuse the key with changed content.
Export through the authorized documented format and read it independently; reimport into a disposable authorized workspace and compare complete semantic inventories.
assertions: Preview and results classify every row as created, reconciled, rejected or unchanged with no hidden failures.
Equal replay reuses its result without duplicates; changed content under the same key returns a conflict.
All exported identities, typed relations, dossiers, profile versions, accessible evidence, evaluations, activities, deadlines and restrictions reconcile after reimport.
Counts may exceed the minimal fixture; every exported item must preserve domain meaning, links and rights, and no forbidden contact is reactivated.

cases.title: Measured recovery and uncertain-operation reconciliation
steps: Declare incident handling, restoration and maximum-data-loss objectives before starting, on the fixture reference workload.
Inject outage and restore an isolated backup containing pending execution, a prior erasure, a suppression and an uncertain transport operation.
Measure recovery and loss against declared objectives, reconcile pending operations and inspect service release and the independent transport ledger.
assertions: Run revision, timestamped chronology, actual recovery/loss measurements, targets and deviations are retained.
Restored restrictions and erasures are effective before service release and contact restart.
Uncertain operations are reconciled before retry and confirmed work is not duplicated; declared incident/recovery objectives are evaluated without inventing a universal recovery threshold.

cases.title: Essential journeys with accessibility, load and user evidence
steps: Execute the configuration, discovery, inbound-form, qualification and follow-up journeys on declared profiles and supported modules.
Collect the linked PR-QA-001 accessibility audit, PR-QA-002 reference-load measurements and PR-QA-008 representative-user study for the same candidate revision.
Inspect keyboard/screen-reader/narrow-screen results, timing distributions and study observations with their limits.
assertions: Each of the three quality cases has attributable reproducible evidence; absent evidence blocks the corresponding claim.
Essential journeys meet the applicable locked thresholds and include alternatives to dragging and accessible errors/status.
Technical timings and small-sample user findings are not represented as commercial improvement.

cases.title: Held-out method comparison and prior release thresholds
steps: Declare enabled capabilities and limitations; freeze authorized held-out cases, annotations/disagreements and business-owner-approved publication/regression thresholds before measuring.
Compare discovery, identity matching, qualification and drafting methods separately against a simple baseline on identical cases, per business profile and target type.
Produce per-profile measurements and a release/rollback decision with corpus, method, target and configuration versions.
assertions: The held-out corpus is separate from tuning and includes ambiguity, unknowns, opposition, source failures and different target types.
Reports retain counts, annotation rules/disagreements, precision, measurable recall or known coverage, errors, abstentions, cost and p50/p95 latency per profile.
Global recall is not claimed for an unknown universe; qualification and drafting are measured separately.
Thresholds and their business owner predate evaluation, regressions affect the publication decision and a withdrawal/rollback path is demonstrated.
Draft objectives and technical comparisons are not acquired performance, more sales or an unbounded SOTA claim.

cases.title: Monitoring and bounded authorized provider cascades
steps: Declare tracked attributes/search, cadence, population, budget and notification conditions; configure ordered fixture providers with separate transfer authorization and a sufficient-result stop rule.
Replay a collective signal change and its notification; separately inject loss of source coverage and an exhausted budget.
Inspect observations, execution/notification identities, historical provenance, target dossiers and provider-call counters; include a denied transfer attempt for the second provider.
assertions: Replay creates no duplicate dossier or logical alert; new candidate, actual change and lost coverage remain distinct.
Cascade order, per-provider permission, stop condition and minimum quality are explicit; later providers are not called after a sufficient result, a denied transfer or exhausted budget.
A returned value remains distinct from verified data; signal source, date, entity and observation level are retained.
A collective signal proves no individual purchase intent, lifts no restriction and proposes review rather than automatic contact.
cases.applicability: Run monitoring when CAP-PR-017 is enabled or advertised. Exercise the cascade phase when that optional mechanism is offered; document absent phases as not_run.

cases.title: Accessibility of all declared essential journeys
steps: Assess configuration, search, public inbound form, qualification and follow-up with automated checks and a manual WCAG 2.2 AA review.
Exercise keyboard-only operation including every drag alternative, screen-reader error/status announcements, reflow at 320 CSS pixels and 200 percent zoom across enabled modules.
assertions: An attributed audit records environment, tools, scope, criteria, findings and remediation for the actual candidate revision.

All declared essential journeys satisfy WCAG 2.2 AA, including keyboard alternatives, announced errors/status, 320 CSS pixel reflow and 200 percent zoom; an adapter boolean or automated scan alone cannot pass this case.

cases.title: Reference-load latency distributions
steps: Provision 100000 fixture dossiers in one disposable workspace and 50 simultaneous authorized users; record data generation, workload mix, sample counts, duration, environment and candidate revision.
Measure complete public ordinary reads, filters and saves separately under load, plus long-operation acknowledgements; retain timestamped samples and compute p95 per operation class.
Inspect explicit maximum durations and progress for discovery and AI when enabled, reporting provider-failure attempts separately.
assertions: The measured load contains 100000 dossiers per workspace and 50 simultaneous users, with enough recorded samples for reproducible p95 distributions.
Each ordinary read/filter/save class has p95 at or below 2000 ms; long-operation acknowledgement is at or below 2000 ms.
Discovery and any AI have explicit maximum duration and progress; provider failure is not included in a guarantee of completed search/model results.
Raw sanitized samples and load metadata are retained; a small synthetic functional fixture alone cannot establish the reference-load claim.

cases.title: Representative-user task study
steps: Recruit at least five representative deployment users, recording population, context and candidate revision.
Observe candidate selection, qualification examination and planning the next action without assistance; record each user task result, help, time and errors.
Publish attributable anonymized study observations and the limitations of the small sample.
assertions: At least five distinct representative users are observed and at least four complete all three named tasks without help.
Time, errors, actual assistance and population/sample limitations are retained; no unsupported commercial gain is inferred.
Missing participant observations or reviewer attribution block this case; synthetic replay rows are harness controls only.
